title: Values of negated inputs
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ assign Boolean values to the $n$ inputs, and let $i$ be an input index. In the circuit consisting of one negation gate for each input, the value at vertex $n+i$ is $
eg x(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
